summary_1line: Brahma explains the immense merit of gifting cows and the severe sin of stealing, selling, or killing them.

image_candidates.scene_text: A devotee who has fasted for three nights presents a healthy cow with her calf to a serene Brahmana beside a sacrificial fire.
A man humbly follows a herd of cows through the forest, living on grass and leaves, seeking purification and divine favor.
In a grim vision of judgment, those who slaughtered a cow suffer in a dark hell measured by the countless hairs of the slain animal.
